description_en: Update an outbound call job by instance ID and job ID
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID更新外呼任务
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs update-ai-outbound-task --instance-id agent_000 --task-id 123 --name 'xxxx外呼' --description '房产销售' --outbound-nums 15000000000 --num-repeated 1 --handler-id 123 --execution-time TUESDAY_:_start_:_06:00_,_end_:_06:05_,_MONDAY_:_start_:_09:00_,_end_:_18:00_,_start_:_20:30_,_end_:_21:45_,_start_:_22:30_,_end_:_22:50_,_WEDNESDAY_:_start_:_09:00_,_end_:_18:00_,_THURSDAY_:_start_:_09:00_,_end_:_18:00_,_FRIDAY_:_start_:_09:00_,_end_:_18:00_,_SATURDAY_:_start_:_09:00_,_end_:_18:00_,_SUNDAY_:_start_:_17:00_,_end_:_23:45 --concurrent-rate 10 --recall-rule Count=2 Interval=5 --forecast-call-rate 1.2 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAiOutboundTask

parameters.description_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
